battery.notes: ~83Wh. OMEN 16/17 chassis with Ryzen AI 9: ~4-5h light use per user reports; drains fast unplugged under load.

offers.name: HP OMEN 17 17.3" 144Hz Gaming Laptop - AMD Ryzen AI 9 365 - 16GB DDR5 - 1TB SSD - RTX 5060 8GB - Windows 11 - Black
HP Omen 17-BD100 Gaming Laptop, 2025, 17.3" 1920x1080 144Hz, AMD 10-Core Ryzen AI 9 365, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060, 16GB DDR5, 1TB SSD, Win11 Home

reviews.quote: Midrange specs done right... a solid midrange gaming machine with specifications just powerful enough to satisfy casual and occasional gamers. The low core temperatures deserve praise as well.

praises: RTX 5060 + Ryzen AI 9 365 at $2,399 sale is the value tier of the OMEN line — solid 1080p-ultra/1440p-medium gaming with DLSS 4
17.3-inch 144Hz panel at this price: big screen without flagship money
Quiet and cool in light use; fans only get audible in gaming
Socketed DDR5 and standard M.2 — cheap to upgrade RAM/storage yourself
Numpad keyboard and full port set (HDMI 2.1, USB-C with DP, Ethernet) for desk use
complaints: Battery ~4-5h light use — mediocre for a Ryzen AI chip
Base 144Hz IPS is dim (~300 nits) with washed-out viewing angles
Plastic deck flexes near the vents; not the sturdiest 17-inch
Average 720p webcam and mics — poor on calls
HP bloat (OMEN Hub nags, McAfee trials) out of the box; marketplace listing (PC Heaven) uses inflated $3,429 regular-price anchor

design_philosophy: HP's big-screen mainstream gaming value play: the OMEN 17 stretches the 2025 OMEN 16 chassis to 17.3 inches at the same price points, prioritising screen size and GPU-per-dollar over thinness, battery, or premium materials. This 16GB RTX 5060 config is the entry value tier of the line.
rating_notes: No numeric pro score found for this config (NBC bot-walled, no accessible review — see SHARED-omen-17.md; nothing fabricated). Ratings inferred from the OMEN 16 (2025) RTX 5060 / Ryzen AI 9 365 sibling tier (BBY 19968864) plus the 17.3-inch delta: screen_size 9.5 (up vs 16-inch), portability 3.5 (down vs 16-inch), battery 5.0 (same chassis, bigger panel).
